verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic categorization of transactions with coded transactions synced directly to the ERP. It also claims real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries, and lists native integrations with QuickBooks Online/Desktop, NetSuite, Xero, Sage Intacct, Dynamics 365 and many others. A syncable-transactions banking endpoint, auto-reconciliation claims, CSV export and an open API round this out. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the accounting sync, and in-depth docs on sync mechanics (field mapping, sync frequency, error handling) beyond marketing-level claims.
